name: ai-workflow
description: The dev-workflow process in one plugin: PRD, tasks, refined issues, /implement-issue, /pr-review, plus grind, peer review, herdr dispatch and the aiw ui.

slack_owner_uid.title: Slack owner user id
slack_owner_uid.description: Slack user id of the PR owner — the @-mention target on grind's closing message, e.g. U01ABCDEF23. Used for nothing else.

slack_review_channel.title: Default Slack review channel
slack_review_channel.description: Channel id for PR review threads when a repo has no entry in channels.json. Optional.
